description: An Orc Shaman in the Shattered Spine has been using dark magic to rally the local Orc tribes, and his power is growing. Gareth Broadshield fears he will unite them into an army capable of threatening Sunstone Keep itself. He wants the Shaman dead before that can happen.
hook: This isn't just about culling some beasts. There's a shaman in the mountains who's trying to unite the Orc clans under one banner. A banner soaked in dark magic and pointed right at our gates. I need a proven warrior to go up there and cut the head off this snake before it strikes. This is a mission of utmost importance.

description: A flock of Harpy Screechers has taken up residence on the cliffs overlooking Port Azure's harbor. Their screeching is maddening and they've been stealing fish directly from the nets, driving the local fishermen to distraction.
hook: Those screechin' bird-women are drivin' us all mad! They steal our catch and keep us up all night with their infernal racket. The Corsairs won't do nothin' about 'em. Maybe you could go up to the cliffs and clear a few out? I can pay, and the whole docks'll be grateful.

description: A beautifully crafted but experimental Iron Cuirass was stolen from Torvin Ironhand's forge in Sunstone Keep. He suspects it was taken to Ironmere to be sold on the black market. He's heard rumors that a Halfling thief named Pippin Thistlefoot is the one trying to sell it.
hook: My new breastplate design! Gone! Right from my own forge! I heard through the grapevine that a little rat named Pippin Thistlefoot is trying to peddle it in Ironmere. That armor is my work, my pride. I can't leave my post here. Get it back for me.

description: Jory Fletchling, a Halfling ranger, is tasked with culling the deer population to keep the Whispering Woods' ecosystem in balance. However, the area he's working in is also frequented by a Dire Wolf. The Circle wants someone to watch his back while he works.
hook: Jory is a fine hunter, but his prey attracts other predators. A large Dire Wolf has been seen in his hunting grounds. He is focused on his task, which leaves him vulnerable. We need you to be his guardian. Keep the wolf away while he does the Circle's work.

description: Zan Taloncrest, a Corsair merchant, has been undercutting Ironmere's smiths by selling cheap, low-quality weapons. Delvin Ironfoot sees this as a threat to his business and reputation. He wants you to rough up Taloncrest to send a message about selling inferior goods in their territory.
hook: That overgrown lizard is flooding the market with rubbish! Swords that'll snap, armor that'll dent if ye sneeze on it. It makes real smiths like me look bad. He needs to learn that his cheap tricks aren't welcome around here. A few bruises should help him remember.

hook: The power in that scroll is different. It's tainted by the same foul energies the Covenant uses. I've sensed it from afar. I need to examine it, to understand the nature of the magic that empowers our enemy. The Shaman will not part with it willingly, of course. Retrieve it for me.

description: Seraphina Moonshadow has had a vision. She believes that Elysia Dawnweaver, the Ashen Covenant's half-elf wizard, is on the verge of unlocking a terrible secret that could empower the Covenant immensely. She has deemed Elysia too dangerous to be left alive and asks you to eliminate her.
hook: I have prayed for guidance, and the light has shown me a dark path forward. The wizard Elysia Dawnweaver delves into secrets that could spell doom for us all. She is a flame that must be extinguished before it becomes an inferno. This is not an act of vengeance, but one of terrible necessity. Will you be the instrument of the light's will?

description: Willow Emberleaf's research camp in the Emberlands is being overrun by Ochre Jellies, attracted by the residual magic of her experiments. They're corroding her equipment and notes. She needs you to clear them out before they ruin everything.
hook: Blasted oozes! They're eating through my tent poles! My research is being dissolved before my eyes. I'm too busy trying to salvage my notes to deal with them. Please, just make them go away! A few well-placed whacks should do it.

description: Luther Pendragon, a fisherman from Ironmere, had a lucky catch and was paid handsomely in Gold Crowns. While celebrating in Port Azure, he believes a fellow fisher, Nissa Proudmore, stole his winnings. He's too intimidated to confront her and wants you to get his gold back.
hook: I won big, friend! Sold a giant tuna for a sack of gold. But I think that Corsair woman, Nissa, slipped somethin' in me drink. Woke up with a sore head and empty pockets. She's got my gold, I know it. I can't face her... she's a tough one. But maybe you could... you know, get it back for a simple fisherman?

hook: Stonehelm's a stubborn dwarf, but he's got a nose for good ore. He's found a new vein, but it's in a rough patch of the mountains. He needs to hold his ground for a few days to make the claim legal. Go up there and make sure nobody bothers him while he works.

hook: There's a little bookworm from my own crew, Cedric Fairfax, who's gotten too big for his britches. He's selling goods in Ironmere on the side, my side. He needs to be reminded who runs the game here. A friendly little 'accident' should send him scurrying back to Port Azure where he belongs.

description: Quillathe Liadon is a tailor for the Sylvan Circle and considers herself a true artist. She covets a specific bolt of rare Silk Cloth that Freya Silverkin in Ironmere has acquired, believing it's wasted on the common designs of the Merchant's Guild. She wants you to liberate it for her.
hook: That woman in Ironmere... she has no vision. She possesses a silk of such exquisite quality, a weave kissed by moonlight, and she will likely turn it into a merchant's tunic or some such drab affair. It is an insult to the craft. I require that silk for a true work of art. Retrieve it for me, and I will ensure you are properly compensated for your... artistic procurement.

description: A young Wyrmling has taken up residence in a cave system in the Shattered Spine. While not fully grown, it's still incredibly dangerous and is already terrorizing the trade routes. Ysolda Battleborn wants it slain before it matures into a far greater threat.
hook: A dragon, even a young one, is a threat we cannot ignore. It's burning caravans and eating livestock in the mountains. If we let it grow, it will become a calamity. I need a warrior of renown to go into its lair and slay the beast. This is the kind of deed that songs are written about. Are you up to the task?

hook: The weave of the Giant Spider's silk is unparalleled. It has a strength and shimmer that no mundane silk can match. I require a large quantity for my new collection. While you're out there, dealing with those eight-legged beasts, do be a dear and gather their silk for me. I'll pay well for it.

hook: That old dwarf in Sunstone Keep... Torvin... he taught me everything I know. But when I left to join the Guild, he took my favorite hammer. Said I didn't deserve it. It was a gift from me own father. I want it back. I can't go there meself, it's too painful. But you could slip in and get it for me.

description: Thalia Nightbreeze has been invited to perform at a grand feast in Sunstone Keep, a gesture of goodwill between the Concord and the Sylvan Circle. Given the political tensions, the Concord wants to ensure her safety during her stay, fearing a provocation from the Ashen Covenant or another hostile party.
hook: The Nightbreeze woman is our guest, and her voice is a gift. But there are those who would see this gesture of friendship fail. Your duty is simple: stay close to her while she's within our walls. Be her shadow. Anyone who looks at her the wrong way answers to you.

hook: I don't care about your morals. There's treasure to be had. A bunch of screaming cultists are sitting on a pile of old trinkets that are worth a fortune to the right people. I need you to go in, make some noise, and get rid of the guards. I'll handle the rest. You'll get your cut.

description: Willow Emberleaf has discovered that the High Priestess Lysandra possesses an Ancient Rune Key that unlocks a vault deep within the Emberlands, a vault she believes contains the secret to controlling the region's volatile magic. She wants you to steal the key from the heart of the Ashen Citadel.
hook: This is it. The key to everything I've been working towards. The High Priestess herself wears it as a trophy, unaware of its true power. I need that key. To steal it from her, in her own fortress... it's madness. But it's the only way. Are you mad enough to try?

description: The Iron Concord has finally had enough of Captain Valeriya Saltspray's piracy and disruption of trade. They have deemed her an enemy of the state and have placed a massive bounty on her head. Arin Greycastle, trusting you completely, is offering you the contract to end her reign for good.
hook: This is it, Stormblade. The big one. Saltspray's treachery has gone on long enough. The Concord has officially sanctioned her removal. Permanently. This is a dangerous mission, but you've proven yourself time and again. Go to Port Azure, find the Captain, and bring an end to her piracy. The peace and prosperity of the entire region depend on it.

description: The Shadow Mastiffs that prowl the outskirts of the Ashen Citadel have grown too aggressive, even attacking Covenant patrols. Sarthax Flamescale, the captain of the guard, wants someone to cull the pack to a more manageable number.
hook: These beasts are useful guardians, but they lack discipline. They've started seeing anything that moves as prey, including my own soldiers. We need to thin the pack. Go out there and remind them who the true predators are.

description: Kaelen Windwalker is to be wed to Thalia Nightbreeze, and he had commissioned a perfect Moonstone Gem from Urist Gemcutter as her wedding gift. However, it was sold to Myrtle Dewdrop by mistake before he could pick it up. Myrtle is now using it in a potent alchemical concoction and refuses to sell it back. Kaelen is desperate.
hook: I am to be married, my friend. To the most beautiful voice in all the woods. I had the perfect gift made... a moonstone that shines like her eyes. But a mix-up at the shop means it's now in the hands of an apothecary in Ironmere, who's using it to brew potions! I must have it back. Please, I beg you, retrieve my love's wedding gift.

hook: The wolves have been getting bolder lately, friend. Found one sniffing around my back door just last night! If you could deal with a few of them, I'd make it worth your while.

He wants you to retrieve it, preferably without causing a scene that would alert the entire Shadow Syndicate.
hook: That slippery little rat Silas made off with my best shield! The one with the dwarven steel inlay—took me a week to forge! Get it back for me, and there's a fresh blade in it for you.

description: The Merchant's Guild is sending a valuable shipment of goods from Sunspear Harbor to Riverwood, and Pippin Thornburrow will be leading the caravan. The roads have become dangerous lately with bandit activity. They need someone to accompany Pippin and ensure both he and the goods arrive safely.
hook: Pippin's taking the eastern road with a cart full of silk and silver. The Guild would feel much better knowing a capable blade was walking beside him. Interested in some honest mercenary work?

input: {"NPCs": {"CaptainValeria": {"Name": "Captain Valeria", "Role": "GuardCaptain", "Faction": "TheIronLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Ironfort", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 45}, {"Target": "VesperTheShadow", "Favorability": -50}]}, "VesperTheShadow": {"Name": "Vesper the Shadow", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "StillwaterMarsh", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -40}, {"Target": "CaptainValeria", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "Factions": {"TheIronLegion": {"Name": "The Iron Legion", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 30}, {"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -50}]}, "TheShadowSyndicate": {"Name": "The Shadow Syndicate", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -15}, {"Target": "TheIronLegion", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "Locations": {"StillwaterMarsh": {"Name": "Stillwater Marsh", "Enemies": ["GiantSpider", "Mudcrab", "Wraith", "Goblin"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Disrupt Syndicate Operations", "Giver": "CaptainValeria", "Actions": ["goto StillwaterMarsh", "damage VesperTheShadow"]}}
description: Captain Valeria has received intelligence that Vesper the Shadow is coordinating a series of robberies from a hideout in Stillwater Marsh. She doesn't need Vesper killed—that would cause too much political fallout—but she wants you to raid the hideout and rough up Vesper enough to send a message and disrupt their operations.
hook: I don't have the authority to send Legion soldiers into the Marsh for an unsanctioned raid. But you... you're not a soldier, are you? Go remind Vesper that the Legion's reach is longer than they think.

input: {"NPCs": {"NyxNightshade": {"Name": "Nyx Nightshade", "Role": "Alchemist", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "StillwaterMarsh", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -25}]}, "CedricTheJeweler": {"Name": "Cedric the Jeweler", "Role": "Jeweler", "Faction": "TheMerchantsGuild", "CurrentLocation": "SunspearHarbor", "OwnedItems": {"SilverRing": 15, "Diamond": 5, "MagicGem": 3, "GoldCoin": 120}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "NyxNightshade", "Favorability": -20}]}}, "Locations": {"SunspearHarbor": {"Name": "Sunspear Harbor", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantRat"]}, "StillwaterMarsh": {"Name": "Stillwater Marsh", "Enemies": ["GiantSpider", "Mudcrab", "Wraith", "Goblin"]}}, "Items": {"Diamond": {"Name": "Diamond", "Type": "Artifact"}}}

description: Nyx Nightshade has her eye on a particularly fine diamond in Cedric the Jeweler's shop in Sunspear Harbor. She wants you to acquire it for her—quietly. Cedric is a nervous man who checks his inventory obsessively, so this will require careful timing. The Syndicate pays well for discretion.
hook: Cedric just got a shipment from the Ebonpeak mines. There's a diamond in that collection that's practically flawless. I want it. You get it for me, and you'll find the Syndicate can be very... appreciative.

input: {"NPCs": {"CaptainValeria": {"Name": "Captain Valeria", "Role": "GuardCaptain", "Faction": "TheIronLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Ironfort", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 45}]}, "GornakSkullcrusher": {"Name": "Gornak Skullcrusher", "Species": "Orc", "Role": "Hunter", "CurrentLocation": "TheUnderdarkChasm", "OwnedItems": {"BanditAxe": 1, "LeatherArmor": 1, "GoldCoin": 20, "TrollFat": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -30}, {"Target": "TheIronLegion", "Favorability": -20}]}}, "Factions": {"TheIronLegion": {"Name": "The Iron Legion", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 30}]}}, "Locations": {"TheUnderdarkChasm": {"Name": "The Underdark Chasm", "Enemies": ["CaveSpider", "SkeletalWarrior", "CaveTroll", "Wraith", "Specter"]}, "Ironfort": {"Name": "Ironfort", "Enemies": ["Bandit", "Wolf", "OrcBerserker"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Eliminate Gornak Skullcrusher", "Giver": "CaptainValeria", "Actions": ["goto TheUnderdarkChasm", "kill GornakSkullcrusher", "goto Ironfort", "report CaptainValeria"]}}
description: Gornak Skullcrusher has been raiding Legion supply lines for months, killing soldiers and stealing equipment. He's holed up somewhere in The Underdark Chasm. Captain Valeria has finally received authorization for a lethal response. She needs someone who won't hesitate to end this threat permanently.
hook: This isn't a job for the faint of heart. Gornak has Legion blood on his hands—good soldiers who had families. I need someone who can find him in that cursed chasm and make sure he never sees the surface again. Are you that someone?

input: {"NPCs": {"VesperTheShadow": {"Name": "Vesper the Shadow", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "StillwaterMarsh", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -40}, {"Target": "SeraphinaFlameheart", "Favorability": -40}]}, "SeraphinaFlameheart": {"Name": "Seraphina Flameheart", "Species": "Dragonborn", "Role": "BountyHunter", "CurrentLocation": "FrostfangMountains", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "LeatherArmor": 1, "GoldCoin": 30, "HealthPotion": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -50}, {"Target": "VesperTheShadow", "Favorability": -45}, {"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -40}]}}, "Factions": {"TheShadowSyndicate": {"Name": "The Shadow Syndicate", "DefaultLocation": "StillwaterMarsh", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Locations": {"FrostfangMountains": {"Name": "Frostfang Mountains", "Enemies": ["DireWolf", "Troll", "OrcShaman", "BloodHarpy"]}, "StillwaterMarsh": {"Name": "Stillwater Marsh", "Enemies": ["GiantSpider", "Mudcrab", "Wraith", "Goblin"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Seraphina's Bounty", "Giver": "VesperTheShadow", "Actions": ["goto FrostfangMountains", "kill SeraphinaFlameheart", "goto StillwaterMarsh", "report VesperTheShadow"]}}
description: Vesper the Shadow has a personal vendetta against Seraphina Flameheart, a dragonborn bounty hunter who's been hunting Syndicate members for months. Seraphina has killed three of Vesper's best thieves. The Shadow Syndicate wants her eliminated, and they're willing to pay handsomely to someone with... flexible morals. This will make you enemies with the Iron Legion if discovered.
hook: Seraphina Flameheart. That name means anything to you? She's killed friends of mine. Good friends. I want her head, and I'm willing to pay enough gold to make you rich. But understand this—you take this job, you're choosing a side. No going back.

input: {"NPCs": {"LysandraTheHerbalist": {"Name": "Lysandra the Herbalist", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Apothecary", "CurrentLocation": "Riverwood", "OwnedItems": {"HealthPotion": 10, "CaveMushroom": 15, "HarpyFeather": 8, "SpiderSilk": 5}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 25}]}}, "Locations": {"VerdantGlade": {"Name": "Verdant Glade", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "GiantSpider", "Harpy", "Specter"], "Resources": ["CaveMushroom", "HarpyFeather", "ManaPotion", "AncientScroll", "MagicGem"]}, "Riverwood": {"Name": "Riverwood", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "Mudcrab", "GiantRat"]}}, "Enemies": {"GiantSpider": {"Name": "Giant Spider", "Loot": ["SpiderSilk", "CaveMushroom"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Herbalist's Supplies", "Giver": "LysandraTheHerbalist", "Actions": ["goto VerdantGlade", "damage GiantSpider", "goto Riverwood", "report LysandraTheHerbalist"]}}
description: Lysandra the Herbalist needs spider silk for her medicinal poultices, but the giant spiders in Verdant Glade have become unusually aggressive. She can't safely harvest what she needs. Clear out some of the spiders so she can gather her supplies in peace.
hook: Those eight-legged terrors have gotten worse lately. I tried to gather silk yesterday and nearly lost a hand! If you could thin their numbers a bit, I'd be happy to share some of my healing brews with you.

input: {"NPCs": {"CedricTheJeweler": {"Name": "Cedric the Jeweler", "Role": "Jeweler", "Faction": "TheMerchantsGuild", "CurrentLocation": "SunspearHarbor", "OwnedItems": {"SilverRing": 15, "Diamond": 5, "MagicGem": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "CaspianTheCunning", "Favorability": -35}]}, "CaspianTheCunning": {"Name": "Caspian the Cunning", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "WhisperingDunes", "OwnedItems": {"SteelDagger": 1, "Lockpick": 10, "SilverRing": 4, "GoldCoin": 55}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -30}, {"Target": "CedricTheJeweler", "Favorability": -35}]}}, "Locations": {"WhisperingDunes": {"Name": "Whispering Dunes", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantSpider", "Skeleton", "Wraith"]}, "SunspearHarbor": {"Name": "Sunspear Harbor", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantRat"]}}, "Items": {"SilverRing": {"Name": "Silver Ring", "Type": "Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Stolen Silver Rings", "Giver": "CedricTheJeweler", "Actions": ["goto WhisperingDunes", "kill CaspianTheCunning", "take SilverRing", "goto SunspearHarbor", "give CedricTheJeweler SilverRing"]}}
description: Cedric the Jeweler is distraught—a collection of silver rings was stolen during the night. He's certain Caspian the Cunning is responsible, as the thief was spotted in Sunspear Harbor around the time of the theft. Caspian has fled to the Whispering Dunes. Cedric doesn't care how you get the rings back, only that you do.
hook: Those rings were commissioned for a noble's wedding! If I don't get them back, my reputation is ruined! Please, find that thief Caspian and recover my silver. I don't care what you have to do—just bring them home!

input: {"Factions": {"TheCircleOfTheCrescent": {"Name": "The Circle of the Crescent", "DefaultLocation": "VerdantGlade", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 5}, {"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -30}], "Members": ["ElaraMoonshadow", "MagisterOrion", "SeleneStarfall", "TaliaSunshadow", "ZargothTheWise", "LyraSilverleaf"]}}, "NPCs": {"MagisterOrion": {"Name": "Magister Orion", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Scholar", "Faction": "TheCircleOfTheCrescent", "CurrentLocation": "VerdantGlade", "OwnedItems": {"WizardsRobes": 1, "AncientScroll": 5, "ManaPotion": 4, "MagicGem": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 5}, {"Target": "NyxNightshade", "Favorability": -20}]}}, "Locations": {"VerdantGlade": {"Name": "Verdant Glade", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "GiantSpider", "Harpy", "Specter"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guard Magister Orion", "Giver": "TheCircleOfTheCrescent", "Actions": ["goto VerdantGlade", "defend MagisterOrion"]}}
description: Magister Orion is conducting a dangerous ritual at the Verdant Glade stone circle, one that will leave him vulnerable for several hours. The Circle of the Crescent fears that agents of the Shadow Syndicate might use this opportunity to attack him. They need someone to stand guard while Orion completes his work.
hook: Orion attempts to commune with the ancients tonight. The ritual requires his complete focus—he'll be defenseless. We've heard whispers that the Syndicate knows about this. Stand watch over him. If anything threatens the Magister, deal with it.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Harass the Merchants", "Giver": "RevasVengeance", "Actions": ["goto SunspearHarbor", "damage QuinnTheQuick"]}}
description: Revas Vengeance wants to send a message to the Merchant's Guild that their protection isn't as solid as they believe. He wants you to rough up Quinn the Quick, one of their prominent merchants, during his evening walk home. Nothing lethal—just enough to make Quinn nervous and the Guild look weak.
hook: Quinn thinks he's untouchable, walking around the Harbor like he owns the place. I want you to remind him that the Syndicate's reach extends everywhere. Shake him up a bit—take his coin purse if you want—but leave him breathing. This is about sending a message.

input: {"NPCs": {"ZargothTheWise": {"Name": "Zargoth the Wise", "Species": "Orc", "Role": "Wizard", "Faction": "TheCircleOfTheCrescent", "CurrentLocation": "VerdantGlade", "OwnedItems": {"WizardsRobes": 1, "ManaPotion": 5, "AncientScroll": 4, "MagicGem": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "AldricTheAged", "Favorability": 40}]}, "AldricTheAged": {"Name": "Aldric the Aged", "Role": "Scholar", "Faction": "TheCircleOfTheCrescent", "CurrentLocation": "VerdantGlade", "OwnedItems": {"AncientScroll": 6, "WizardsRobes": 1, "ManaPotion": 2, "GoldCoin": 25}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "ZargothTheWise", "Favorability": 40}]}}, "Locations": {"VerdantGlade": {"Name": "Verdant Glade", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "GiantSpider", "Harpy", "Specter"]}}, "Items": {"AncientScroll": {"Name": "Ancient Scroll", "Type": "Book"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Steal Ancient Scrolls", "Giver": "ZargothTheWise", "Actions": ["goto VerdantGlade", "stealth AldricTheAged", "take AncientScroll", "goto VerdantGlade", "give ZargothTheWise AncientScroll"]}}
description: Zargoth the Wise has been denied access to certain ancient scrolls by Aldric the Aged, who claims Zargoth isn't ready for their contents. Zargoth disagrees vehemently and wants those scrolls. He can't take them himself without causing a rift in the Circle, but you're not a member. He wants you to acquire the scrolls discreetly.
hook: Aldric hoards knowledge like a dragon hoards gold. There are scrolls in his study that I need for my research—scrolls about orcish heritage that are rightfully mine to study. I cannot take them myself, but you... you owe no allegiance to the Circle's petty politics. Bring them to me, and I'll share their secrets.

description: Brom the Miner reports that cave spiders have infested one of the main mining tunnels in Ebonpeak. The miners are afraid to enter, and production is falling behind. The Stonelord Assembly needs those tunnels cleared so work can resume. Kill enough spiders to make the tunnel safe again.
hook: Can't get a proper day's work done with those eight-legged bastards crawling everywhere! Lost a good pickaxe to their webs yesterday. Clear 'em out of the eastern tunnel, and I'll make sure you get a share of the ore we pull out.

description: Mayor Alistair's personal iron key has been stolen—a key that opens several important chests in Riverwood's town hall. He believes Jax the Jester, that insufferable halfling performer who passed through town last week, is responsible. Jax has been spotted in Sunspear Harbor. Alistair needs that key back before anyone discovers it's missing.
hook: This is rather embarrassing, but my personal key has gone missing. If certain people in town knew, it would undermine confidence in my leadership. I'm certain that jester took it—he was far too interested in my office during his performance. Find him. Get my key back. Quietly.

input: {"Factions": {"TheStonelordAssembly": {"Name": "The Stonelord Assembly", "DefaultLocation": "Ebonpeak", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 0}, {"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -5}], "Members": ["GrimmStoutale", "TorvinIronfoot", "RoricStonebeard", "DroganHammerhand", "BromTheMiner", "FioraFlint", "BeatriceTheBold", "TiberiusStone"]}}, "NPCs": {"GrimmStoutale": {"Name": "Grimm Stoutale", "Species": "Dwarf", "Role": "GuardCaptain", "Faction": "TheStonelordAssembly", "CurrentLocation": "Ebonpeak", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "GoldCoin": 75, "IronOre": 5, "CaveMushroom": 4}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -5}, {"Target": "VesperTheShadow", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Locations": {"Ebonpeak": {"Name": "Ebonpeak", "Enemies": ["CaveTroll", "CaveSpider", "OrcBerserker", "Skeleton"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guard the Assembly Meeting", "Giver": "TheStonelordAssembly", "Actions": ["goto Ebonpeak", "defend GrimmStoutale"]}}
description: The Stonelord Assembly is holding an important meeting at Ebonpeak to discuss mining rights with representatives from Ironfort. Grimm Stoutale will be leading the Assembly's delegation. They're concerned about potential interference from the Shadow Syndicate, who would love to disrupt dwarf-human relations. Guard Grimm during the meeting.
hook: These negotiations are delicate. If something were to happen to Grimm during the talks, it could set back relations with Ironfort for years. Stand guard. Look intimidating. Make sure no 'accidents' occur while we hammer out this agreement.

input: {"NPCs": {"AstridBattleborn": {"Name": "Astrid Battleborn", "Role": "GuardCaptain", "Faction": "TheIronLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Ironfort", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 40}, {"Target": "VesperTheShadow", "Favorability": -48}]}, "YaraGreymane": {"Name": "Yara Greymane", "Species": "Tiefling", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "StillwaterMarsh", "OwnedItems": {"SteelDagger": 1, "Lockpick": 8, "SpiderSilk": 4, "GoldCoin": 35}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Factions": {"TheIronLegion": {"Name": "The Iron Legion", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "Locations": {"StillwaterMarsh": {"Name": "Stillwater Marsh", "Enemies": ["GiantSpider", "Mudcrab", "Wraith", "Goblin"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Attack the Syndicate Courier", "Giver": "AstridBattleborn", "Actions": ["goto StillwaterMarsh", "damage YaraGreymane"]}}
description: Astrid Battleborn has learned that Yara Greymane is carrying sensitive Syndicate documents between Stillwater Marsh and Whispering Dunes. She wants you to intercept Yara, rough her up, and take the documents. Astrid doesn't want Yara killed—the documents are the real prize, and a dead courier teaches no lessons.
hook: Yara moves messages for the Syndicate. Today she's carrying something important—we don't know what, but Vesper doesn't use his best people for routine deliveries. Find her on the marsh road. Take those documents. Leave her bruised but breathing—I want her to tell Vesper exactly who outmaneuvered him.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Steal Troll Fat", "Giver": "DelilahDusk", "Actions": ["goto TheUnderdarkChasm", "stealth GornakSkullcrusher", "take TrollFat", "goto StillwaterMarsh", "give DelilahDusk TrollFat"]}}
description: Delilah Dusk needs troll fat for her alchemical experiments, but trolls are dangerous to hunt. She's heard that Gornak Skullcrusher has been killing trolls in The Underdark Chasm and stockpiling their fat. She wants you to steal some from Gornak's camp. This is dangerous—Gornak is violent and unpredictable—but Delilah's paying well.
hook: Gornak's been hoarding troll fat like it's liquid gold. I need it for my work, and I'd rather not get my skull crushed trying to negotiate with that orc. Sneak into his camp, grab what you can carry, and get out. I'll make it worth the risk.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Eliminate the Traitor", "Giver": "MagisterOrion", "Actions": ["goto StillwaterMarsh", "kill NyxNightshade", "goto VerdantGlade", "report MagisterOrion"]}}
description: Magister Orion has discovered that Nyx Nightshade was once an initiate of the Circle of the Crescent—a promising alchemist who stole forbidden texts and fled to the Shadow Syndicate. She's been using Circle knowledge to create poisons for the Syndicate. The Circle has declared her a traitor and authorized her elimination. This is a test of loyalty and discretion.
hook: Nyx was one of us, once. She betrayed our trust, stole our secrets, and now uses them to empower our enemies. The Circle cannot let this stand. Find her in the Marsh. End her threat to our order. Do this, and you will have earned our deepest trust.

input: {"NPCs": {"YasminOfTheDunes": {"Name": "Yasmin of the Dunes", "Role": "Ranger", "CurrentLocation": "WhisperingDunes", "OwnedItems": {"HuntersBow": 1, "IronArrows": 15, "HealthPotion": 2, "WolfPelt": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Locations": {"WhisperingDunes": {"Name": "Whispering Dunes", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantSpider", "Skeleton", "Wraith"], "Resources": ["GoldCoin", "Lockpick", "SteelDagger", "AncientScroll", "SilverRing"]}}, "Enemies": {"Wraith": {"Name": "Wraith", "Loot": ["MagicGem", "AncientScroll", "GoldCoin"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Wraiths in the Dunes", "Giver": "YasminOfTheDunes", "Actions": ["goto WhisperingDunes", "damage Wraith", "goto WhisperingDunes", "report YasminOfTheDunes"]}}
description: Yasmin of the Dunes reports that wraiths have been appearing near the ancient burial mounds in the Whispering Dunes. They're attacking travelers and making her hunting grounds dangerous. She needs someone to destroy several of these restless spirits so the dunes are safe again.
hook: The dead don't rest easy in the dunes. Something's stirred them up—wraiths, floating through the night, hungry for the living. I can't hunt properly with those things drifting about. Put a few of them to final rest, and I'll give you a bow worthy of the task.

input: {"NPCs": {"FioraFlint": {"Name": "Fiora Flint", "Species": "Dwarf", "Role": "Miner", "Faction": "TheStonelordAssembly", "CurrentLocation": "Ebonpeak", "OwnedItems": {"IronOre": 18, "Diamond": 1, "GoldCoin": 45, "SturdyShield": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 15}]}, "CaspianTheCunning": {"Name": "Caspian the Cunning", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "WhisperingDunes", "OwnedItems": {"SteelDagger": 1, "Lockpick": 10, "SilverRing": 4, "GoldCoin": 55}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -30}]}}, "Locations": {"WhisperingDunes": {"Name": "Whispering Dunes", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantSpider", "Skeleton", "Wraith"]}, "Ebonpeak": {"Name": "Ebonpeak", "Enemies": ["CaveTroll", "CaveSpider", "OrcBerserker", "Skeleton"]}}, "Items": {"Diamond": {"Name": "Diamond", "Type": "Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Retrieve the Stolen Diamond", "Giver": "FioraFlint", "Actions": ["goto WhisperingDunes", "kill CaspianTheCunning", "take Diamond", "goto Ebonpeak", "give FioraFlint Diamond"]}}
description: Fiora Flint is furious—a diamond she personally mined, one of the finest ever pulled from Ebonpeak, was stolen during transport to Sunspear Harbor. She's tracked it to Caspian the Cunning, who's fled to the Whispering Dunes. Fiora wants her diamond back, and she doesn't care what happens to the thief.
hook: That diamond was my pride! Three months I spent digging it out, and some smooth-talking thief makes off with it? I want it back. Find Caspian. Take back what's mine. And if he resists... well, the dunes are a fine place to bury someone.

input: {"NPCs": {"Elderic": {"Name": "Elderic", "Role": "Innkeeper", "CurrentLocation": "Riverwood", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "FinnTheFisherman", "Favorability": 25}]}, "FinnTheFisherman": {"Name": "Finn the Fisherman", "Role": "Fisherman", "CurrentLocation": "Riverwood", "OwnedItems": {"Riverfish": 20, "GoldCoin": 10, "BreadLoaf": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 5}, {"Target": "SilasTheSly", "Favorability": -15}]}}, "Locations": {"Riverwood": {"Name": "Riverwood", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "Mudcrab", "GiantRat"], "Resources": ["Riverfish", "BreadLoaf", "IronOre", "CaveMushroom"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guard the Fisherman", "Giver": "Elderic", "Actions": ["goto Riverwood", "defend FinnTheFisherman"]}}
description: Finn the Fisherman has been threatened by someone he owes money to—likely a Syndicate loan shark. He's afraid to go down to the river alone, and the village needs his catch. Elderic wants you to accompany Finn on his fishing trips for a few days, keeping an eye out for trouble.
hook: Poor Finn's scared to go near the water. Owed some silver to the wrong people, I reckon. Can't blame him—those Syndicate types don't make idle threats. Just stand watch while he does his fishing. If anyone shows up looking for payment, convince them to extend his deadline.

input: {"NPCs": {"SilasTheSly": {"Name": "Silas the Sly", "Species": "Halfling", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "Riverwood", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -10}, {"Target": "TheMerchantsGuild", "Favorability": -30}]}, "TorvinIronfoot": {"Name": "Torvin Ironfoot", "Species": "Dwarf", "Role": "Miner", "Faction": "TheStonelordAssembly", "CurrentLocation": "Ebonpeak", "OwnedItems": {"IronOre": 15, "GoldCoin": 45, "CaveMushroom": 3, "SturdyShield": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Factions": {"TheShadowSyndicate": {"Name": "The Shadow Syndicate", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheStonelordAssembly", "Favorability": -5}]}, "TheStonelordAssembly": {"Name": "The Stonelord Assembly", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -5}]}}, "Locations": {"Ebonpeak": {"Name": "Ebonpeak", "Enemies": ["CaveTroll", "CaveSpider", "OrcBerserker", "Skeleton"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Attack the Stonelord Supply Line", "Giver": "SilasTheSly", "Actions": ["goto Ebonpeak", "damage TorvinIronfoot"]}}
description: Silas the Sly wants to disrupt the Stonelord Assembly's iron ore shipments. He's identified Torvin Ironfoot as the foreman of the main supply route. Rough up Torvin and destroy his shipment manifest. This will delay their deliveries for weeks and give the Syndicate leverage in negotiations.
hook: The dwarves think they can just dig up the mountains and ship their ore wherever they please, without paying proper 'taxes' to the Syndicate. Torvin's the key to their operation. Pay him a visit. Break a few things. Remind him that the Marsh has long arms.

input: {"NPCs": {"AnyaWinterbreeze": {"Name": "Anya Winterbreeze", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Wizard", "CurrentLocation": "FrostfangMountains", "OwnedItems": {"WizardsRobes": 1, "ManaPotion": 3, "MagicGem": 1, "AncientScroll": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "ElaraMoonshadow", "Favorability": 15}]}, "ElaraMoonshadow": {"Name": "Elara Moonshadow", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Wizard", "Faction": "TheCircleOfTheCrescent", "CurrentLocation": "VerdantGlade", "OwnedItems": {"WizardsRobes": 1, "ManaPotion": 3, "AncientScroll": 2, "MagicGem": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "AnyaWinterbreeze", "Favorability": 5}]}}, "Locations": {"VerdantGlade": {"Name": "Verdant Glade", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "GiantSpider", "Harpy", "Specter"]}, "FrostfangMountains": {"Name": "Frostfang Mountains", "Enemies": ["DireWolf", "Troll", "OrcShaman", "BloodHarpy"]}}, "Items": {"WizardsRobes": {"Name": "Wizard's Robes", "Type": "Armor"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Steal Wizards' Robes", "Giver": "AnyaWinterbreeze", "Actions": ["goto VerdantGlade", "stealth ElaraMoonshadow", "take WizardsRobes", "goto FrostfangMountains", "give AnyaWinterbreeze WizardsRobes"]}}
description: Anya Winterbreeze has been denied membership in the Circle of the Crescent despite her magical talents. She believes this is due to prejudice against her isolation in the Frostfang Mountains. She wants a set of official Circle robes—specifically Elara Moonshadow's—to study their enchantments and, admittedly, to prove she can acquire them.
hook: The Circle looks down on me because I prefer the mountain's solitude to their glade's politics. Elara's robes are imbued with protective enchantments I wish to understand. I don't want to hurt anyone, but I do want those robes. Bring them to me, and I'll share what I learn from them.

input: {"NPCs": {"WrenWillowwood": {"Name": "Wren Willowwood", "Species": "Halfling", "Role": "Farmer", "Faction": "TheCircleOfTheCrescent", "CurrentLocation": "VerdantGlade", "OwnedItems": {"HealthPotion": 4, "CaveMushroom": 6, "SpiderSilk": 3, "BreadLoaf": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 25}]}}, "Locations": {"VerdantGlade": {"Name": "Verdant Glade", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "GiantSpider", "Harpy", "Specter", "Goblin"]}}, "Enemies": {"Goblin": {"Name": "Goblin", "Loot": ["GoblinEar", "GoldCoin", "SteelDagger"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Goblin Raiders", "Giver": "WrenWillowwood", "Actions": ["goto VerdantGlade", "damage Goblin", "goto VerdantGlade", "report WrenWillowwood"]}}
description: Wren Willowwood's farm on the outskirts of Verdant Glade has been raided by goblins. They've stolen crops and scared her workers. She needs someone to drive the goblins away from her land—killing enough of them that the survivors learn to stay away.
hook: Those little green menaces came right up to my fence line! Took half my harvest of mushrooms and scared my farmhands half to death. I can't afford to lose more. Teach those goblins that Willowwood Farm isn't their personal pantry.

input: {"NPCs": {"NixFizzlespark": {"Name": "Nix Fizzlespark", "Species": "Gnome", "Role": "Alchemist", "CurrentLocation": "Ironfort", "OwnedItems": {"ManaPotion": 5, "MagicGem": 2, "AncientScroll": 1, "HealthPotion": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 15}]}, "DelilahDusk": {"Name": "Delilah Dusk", "Species": "Tiefling", "Role": "Alchemist", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "StillwaterMarsh", "OwnedItems": {"SteelDagger": 2, "HealthPotion": 3, "SpiderSilk": 5, "GoldCoin": 40}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -20}]}}, "Locations": {"StillwaterMarsh": {"Name": "Stillwater Marsh", "Enemies": ["GiantSpider", "Mudcrab", "Wraith", "Goblin"]}, "Ironfort": {"Name": "Ironfort", "Enemies": ["Bandit", "Wolf", "OrcBerserker"]}}, "Items": {"AncientScroll": {"Name": "Ancient Scroll", "Type": "Book"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Alchemist's Formula", "Giver": "NixFizzlespark", "Actions": ["goto StillwaterMarsh", "stealth DelilahDusk", "take AncientScroll", "goto Ironfort", "give NixFizzlespark AncientScroll"]}}
description: Nix Fizzlespark is distraught—an ancient scroll containing a rare alchemical formula was stolen from his workshop. He believes Delilah Dusk, a rival alchemist from the Shadow Syndicate, is responsible. He needs that scroll back; it contains the only known formula for a potion he's been developing for years.
hook: That scroll was my life's work! Well, not mine—it's ancient—but the formula! I was so close to replicating it! Delilah must have heard about my progress. Please, find her and get my scroll back. I don't care how you do it. Just bring it home.

input: {"Factions": {"TheIronLegion": {"Name": "The Iron Legion", "DefaultLocation": "Ironfort", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 30}, {"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -50}]}}, "NPCs": {"NixFizzlespark": {"Name": "Nix Fizzlespark", "Species": "Gnome", "Role": "Alchemist", "CurrentLocation": "Ironfort", "OwnedItems": {"ManaPotion": 5, "MagicGem": 2, "AncientScroll": 1, "HealthPotion": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "TheIronLegion", "Favorability": 10}]}}, "Locations": {"Ironfort": {"Name": "Ironfort", "Enemies": ["Bandit", "Wolf", "OrcBerserker"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guard the Alchemist", "Giver": "TheIronLegion", "Actions": ["goto Ironfort", "defend NixFizzlespark"]}}
description: Nix Fizzlespark is working on an important project for the Iron Legion—a new type of healing potion that could save soldiers' lives. The Legion has received intelligence that the Shadow Syndicate might attempt to sabotage his work. They want someone to guard Nix while he completes the final stages of his research.
hook: Nix is close to a breakthrough—something that could change the tide of every skirmish we fight. The Syndicate knows it too. We need eyes on him, day and night, until he's done. Anyone suspicious comes near that workshop, you deal with them.

input: {"NPCs": {"DariusTheDaring": {"Name": "Darius the Daring", "Role": "BountyHunter", "Faction": "TheIronLegion", "CurrentLocation": "TheGoldenPlain", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "LeatherArmor": 1, "GoldCoin": 25, "HealthPotion": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 35}]}}, "Locations": {"TheGoldenPlain": {"Name": "The Golden Plain", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "Bandit", "Harpy", "BanditMarauder"], "Resources": ["WolfPelt", "HarpyFeather", "IronOre", "HealthPotion"]}}, "Enemies": {"BanditMarauder": {"Name": "Bandit Marauder", "Loot": ["BanditAxe", "LeatherArmor", "GoldCoin", "HealthPotion"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Attack the Bandit Camp", "Giver": "DariusTheDaring", "Actions": ["goto TheGoldenPlain", "damage BanditMarauder"]}}
description: Darius the Daring has located a bandit camp in The Golden Plain that's been waylaying travelers. He wants to hit them hard—specifically targeting their leader, a Bandit Marauder who's been organizing the raids. Take out the leader, and the rest will scatter.
hook: Found their camp—nestled in a hollow just off the main road. Their leader's a nasty piece of work, calls himself 'The Marauder.' Take him down, and the rest will run like rabbits. Simple work for someone who knows which end of a sword to hold.

input: {"NPCs": {"JaxTheJester": {"Name": "Jax the Jester", "Species": "Halfling", "Role": "Bard", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "SunspearHarbor", "OwnedItems": {"Lockpick": 5, "SteelDagger": 1, "SilverRing": 2, "GoldCoin": 45}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -5}]}, "XanderTheXenial": {"Name": "Xander the Xenial", "Species": "Dragonborn", "Role": "Merchant", "Faction": "TheMerchantsGuild", "CurrentLocation": "SunspearHarbor", "OwnedItems": {"GoldCoin": 110, "Diamond": 2, "SilverRing": 5, "MagicGem": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 20}]}}, "Locations": {"SunspearHarbor": {"Name": "Sunspear Harbor", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantRat"]}, "StillwaterMarsh": {"Name": "Stillwater Marsh", "Enemies": ["GiantSpider", "Mudcrab", "Wraith", "Goblin"]}}, "Items": {"GoldCoin": {"Name": "Gold Coin", "Type": "Currency"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Steal the Merchant's Gold", "Giver": "JaxTheJester", "Actions": ["goto SunspearHarbor", "stealth XanderTheXenial", "take GoldCoin", "goto StillwaterMarsh", "give JaxTheJester GoldCoin"]}}
description: Jax the Jester has identified Xander the Xenial as a soft target—a wealthy merchant who keeps too much gold in his home rather than the Guild vault. He wants you to liberate some of that gold. Jax finds the whole thing hilarious and promises to share both the gold and the joke.
hook: Xander! Oh, Xander the Generous, Xander the Welcoming, Xander the... Foolish! The man keeps his gold under his bed. Under his bed! Like a child hiding sweets! It would be almost criminal not to teach him better security practices. Relieve him of some of that burden. We'll split it, and I'll write a very funny song about it.

input: {"NPCs": {"TaliaSunshadow": {"Name": "Talia Sunshadow", "Species": "Elf", "Role": "Ranger", "Faction": "TheCircleOfTheCrescent", "CurrentLocation": "VerdantGlade", "OwnedItems": {"HuntersBow": 1, "IronArrows": 20, "HarpyFeather": 3, "WolfPelt": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Locations": {"VerdantGlade": {"Name": "Verdant Glade", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "GiantSpider", "Harpy", "Specter"], "Resources": ["CaveMushroom", "HarpyFeather", "ManaPotion", "AncientScroll", "MagicGem"]}}, "Enemies": {"Harpy": {"Name": "Harpy", "Loot": ["HarpyFeather", "GoldCoin"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Harpy Hunt", "Giver": "TaliaSunshadow", "Actions": ["goto VerdantGlade", "damage Harpy", "goto VerdantGlade", "report TaliaSunshadow"]}}
description: Talia Sunshadow reports that harpies have been nesting too close to the sacred groves of Verdant Glade. Their screeching disturbs the rituals, and they've been known to attack Circle members gathering herbs. She needs someone to thin their numbers and collect feathers for Circle use.
hook: The harpies have grown bold. Yesterday one tried to snatch Selene's ritual chalice right from the altar! We need to remind them that the Glade belongs to the Circle. Bring me feathers as proof of your hunt, and I'll see you're properly rewarded.

input: {"NPCs": {"IsoldeTheFair": {"Name": "Isolde the Fair", "Role": "Bard", "CurrentLocation": "Riverwood", "OwnedItems": {"SilverRing": 2, "BreadLoaf": 3, "GoldCoin": 20, "HealthPotion": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 25}]}, "RevasVengeance": {"Name": "Revas Vengeance", "Species": "Tiefling", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "WhisperingDunes", "OwnedItems": {"SteelDagger": 2, "Lockpick": 10, "HealthPotion": 1, "SilverRing": 3}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -20}]}}, "Locations": {"StillwaterMarsh": {"Name": "Stillwater Marsh", "Enemies": ["GiantSpider", "Mudcrab", "Wraith", "Goblin"]}, "Riverwood": {"Name": "Riverwood", "Enemies": ["Wolf", "Mudcrab", "GiantRat"]}}, "Items": {"SilverRing": {"Name": "Silver Ring", "Type": "Artifact"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Betrayed Ring", "Giver": "IsoldeTheFair", "Actions": ["goto StillwaterMarsh", "stealth RevasVengeance", "take SilverRing", "goto Riverwood", "give IsoldeTheFair SilverRing"]}}
description: Isolde the Fair is heartbroken. A silver ring—a family heirloom given to her by her grandmother—was stolen by someone she trusted. She'd been seeing a charming tiefling who passed through Riverwood, but he disappeared one night along with her ring. She's since learned his real name is Revas Vengeance, and he's with the Shadow Syndicate in Stillwater Marsh.
hook: He said he loved my singing. Said I had the voice of a goddess. And all the while, he was just waiting to rob me blind! That ring was my grandmother's—the only thing of hers I have left. Please, find Revas. Get my ring back. I don't want him hurt, I just... I just want my grandmother's ring.

input: {"Factions": {"TheMerchantsGuild": {"Name": "The Merchant's Guild", "DefaultLocation": "SunspearHarbor", "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 15}, {"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -20}], "Members": ["PippinThornburrow", "CedricTheJeweler", "CoraTheTailor", "QuinnTheQuick", "XanderTheXenial", "RosalindTheRed"]}}, "NPCs": {"CedricTheJeweler": {"Name": "Cedric the Jeweler", "Role": "Jeweler", "Faction": "TheMerchantsGuild", "CurrentLocation": "SunspearHarbor", "OwnedItems": {"SilverRing": 15, "Diamond": 5, "MagicGem": 3, "GoldCoin": 120}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 10}, {"Target": "TheShadowSyndicate", "Favorability": -25}]}}, "Locations": {"SunspearHarbor": {"Name": "Sunspear Harbor", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantRat"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Guard the Jeweler's Shipment", "Giver": "TheMerchantsGuild", "Actions": ["goto SunspearHarbor", "defend CedricTheJeweler"]}}
description: Cedric the Jeweler is receiving a valuable shipment of gems from the Ebonpeak mines—diamonds and magic gems worth a small fortune. The Merchant's Guild is concerned about Syndicate interference. They want someone to guard Cedric during the transfer of goods from the caravan to his shop.
hook: Cedric's getting his quarterly gem shipment today. If the Syndicate were to strike, this would be the moment. Stand with him, look menacing, and make sure every diamond makes it into his strongbox. The Guild takes care of those who protect its interests.

input: {"NPCs": {"StenGrimjaw": {"Name": "Sten Grimjaw", "Species": "Orc", "Role": "BountyHunter", "Faction": "TheIronLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Ironfort", "OwnedItems": {"BanditAxe": 1, "LeatherArmor": 1, "GoldCoin": 20, "TrollFat": 2}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 20}]}}, "Locations": {"FrostfangMountains": {"Name": "Frostfang Mountains", "Enemies": ["DireWolf", "Troll", "OrcShaman", "BloodHarpy", "OrcBerserker"]}}, "Enemies": {"OrcBerserker": {"Name": "Orc Berserker", "Loot": ["BanditAxe", "LeatherArmor", "GoldCoin", "HealthPotion"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Attack the Orc Camp", "Giver": "StenGrimjaw", "Actions": ["goto FrostfangMountains", "damage OrcBerserker"]}}
description: Sten Grimjaw has located an orc camp in the Frostfang Mountains that's been launching raids on Legion outposts. He wants to strike back—specifically targeting their berserker leader. Sten doesn't want to wipe out the whole camp (that would take an army), but crippling their leadership will send a strong message.
hook: Orcs think the mountains belong to them. They've been testing our defenses, seeing how far they can push. Their berserker leader is the driving force—a big brute with more rage than sense. Put him down, and the rest will think twice about raiding Legion territory.

input: {"NPCs": {"CaspianTheCunning": {"Name": "Caspian the Cunning", "Role": "Thief", "Faction": "TheShadowSyndicate", "CurrentLocation": "WhisperingDunes", "OwnedItems": {"SteelDagger": 1, "Lockpick": 10, "SilverRing": 4, "GoldCoin": 55}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": -30}]}, "EamonTheErudite": {"Name": "Eamon the Erudite", "Species": "Gnome", "Role": "Scholar", "CurrentLocation": "Ironfort", "OwnedItems": {"AncientScroll": 4, "MagicGem": 2, "ManaPotion": 2, "GoldCoin": 20}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 15}]}}, "Locations": {"Ironfort": {"Name": "Ironfort", "Enemies": ["Bandit", "Wolf", "OrcBerserker"]}, "WhisperingDunes": {"Name": "Whispering Dunes", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantSpider", "Skeleton", "Wraith"]}}, "Items": {"AncientScroll": {"Name": "Ancient Scroll", "Type": "Book"}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Steal the Scholar's Research", "Giver": "CaspianTheCunning", "Actions": ["goto Ironfort", "stealth EamonTheErudite", "take AncientScroll", "goto WhisperingDunes", "give CaspianTheCunning AncientScroll"]}}
description: Caspian the Cunning has been hired by an anonymous client to acquire research notes from a gnome scholar in Ironfort named Eamon the Erudite. The notes apparently contain information about ancient ruins in the Whispering Dunes. Caspian is passing the job to you—he's too well-known in Ironfort to show his face.
hook: Eamon's been digging into things he shouldn't. Old things. Buried things. My client wants his research, and I want my cut. You're fresh enough that Ironfort won't recognize you. Get into Eamon's study, take his scrolls, and meet me in the Dunes. Simple, clean, profitable.

input: {"NPCs": {"MasterChen": {"Name": "Master Chen", "Role": "Priest", "CurrentLocation": "SunspearHarbor", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "GoldCoin": 40, "BreadLoaf": 4}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 25}]}}, "Locations": {"WhisperingDunes": {"Name": "Whispering Dunes", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantSpider", "Skeleton", "Wraith"], "Resources": ["GoldCoin", "Lockpick", "SteelDagger", "AncientScroll", "SilverRing"]}, "SunspearHarbor": {"Name": "Sunspear Harbor", "Enemies": ["BanditMarauder", "GiantRat"]}}, "Enemies": {"Skeleton": {"Name": "Skeleton", "Loot": ["IronSword", "GoldCoin", "AncientScroll"]}}}
output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Skeleton Uprising", "Giver": "MasterChen", "Actions": ["goto WhisperingDunes", "damage Skeleton", "goto SunspearHarbor", "report MasterChen"]}}
description: Master Chen has received disturbing reports from travelers—skeletons have been seen rising from ancient graves in the Whispering Dunes, and some have wandered dangerously close to the trade routes. As a priest, he finds this deeply troubling and wants the undead returned to their rest.
hook: The dead should remain dead. Something has disturbed them—perhaps grave robbers, perhaps darker forces. I cannot leave my shrine to investigate, but you can. Find these walking bones and grant them the final rest they deserve. It is a mercy, truly.

description: Cora the Tailor received a ransom note—a silver ring belonging to her sister is being held by someone named Yara Greymane in Stillwater Marsh. The note demands an outrageous sum Cora can't afford. She's desperate and willing to pay you to retrieve the ring by any means necessary.
hook: They have my sister's ring! It's not valuable—just sentimental—but they think I'm a wealthy Guild member who'll pay anything. I can't pay their ransom. I can barely keep my shop running! Please, find this Yara person. Get the ring back. I don't care what you have to do—just bring it home.

description: The Stonelord Assembly is sending a delegation led by Roric Stonebeard to negotiate mining rights in a contested cave system. Drogan Hammerhand will accompany him as protection, but the Assembly wants additional security. They've heard rumors that someone—likely the Syndicate—wants to disrupt these negotiations.
hook: Roric's got the silver tongue of the Assembly. Drogan's got the hammer arm. But two dwarves, even skilled ones, can be overwhelmed. We need a third set of eyes, someone who can watch for threats while they focus on the negotiations. Keep them safe, and the Assembly will remember.

description: Vesper the Shadow wants to intercept Circle communications. Lyra Silverleaf regularly carries messages between Verdant Glade and Riverwood. Vesper wants you to ambush her, take her message satchel, and rough her up enough that she'll think twice about traveling alone. He specifically wants her alive—a dead courier brings too much heat.
hook: Lyra moves between the Glade and the village like a little silver fish. Too trusting, that one. Takes the same path every time. Intercept her. Take her satchel. Make it clear that the roads aren't safe for Circle messengers anymore. But keep her breathing—I want her to tell Orion exactly who's watching.

description: Eamon the Erudite believes that Zargoth the Wise is hoarding magic gems that rightfully belong to the broader scholarly community. He claims Zargoth acquired them through aggressive negotiations with traveling merchants. Eamon wants you to liberate some of these gems so he can study their properties. He justifies this as redistributing knowledge.
hook: Knowledge shouldn't be locked away! Those gems could advance our understanding of enchantment by decades, but Zargoth keeps them in a chest under his bed like a miser. I've tried reasoning with him. I've tried appealing to the Circle. Nothing. So I'm appealing to you. Bring me those gems, and I'll share everything I learn.

description: Seraphina Flameheart has been tracking a pack of dire wolves in the Frostfang Mountains. They're larger and more aggressive than normal wolves, and they've been killing mountain goats that local hunters depend on. She wants help thinning the pack before they turn to hunting people.
hook: Dire wolves. Bigger, smarter, meaner than their smaller cousins. This pack's been devastating the mountain goat population. Hungry wolves are desperate wolves, and desperate wolves attack travelers. Help me thin their numbers, and you can keep whatever pelts you harvest.

description: Ulfgar Thunderfist's ancestral forging hammer was stolen during a raid on a supply caravan. The hammer itself isn't magically special, but it's been in his family for seven generations. He's tracked it to Gornak Skullcrusher in The Underdark Chasm. Ulfgar wants it back—and he wants Gornak to pay for taking it.
hook: That hammer was my grandfather's grandfather's. It's not enchanted. It's not made of rare metals. But every Thunderfist for seven generations has forged their masterwork with it. Gornak took it from me. I want it back, and I want you to make sure he never takes anything from anyone again.

description: Cora the Tailor has received threats after refusing to pay protection money to the Shadow Syndicate. The Merchant's Guild wants someone to watch her shop for a few nights, just in case the Syndicate decides to make an example of her.
hook: Cora stood up to them. Refused their 'protection' demands. Brave woman, but bravery needs backup. Spend a few nights watching her shop. If anyone shows up looking to teach her a lesson, you teach them one instead.

description: Delilah Dusk wants to test the Stonelord Assembly's security. She's identified Beatrice the Bold as a guard captain who patrols the lower mines alone at night. Rough her up, take her patrol schedule, and leave her alive to spread fear among the other guards. This is about psychological warfare.
hook: The dwarves think their mountain makes them safe. Beatrice patrols the lower tunnels every night, same route, same time. Predictable. Show her she's not as safe as she thinks. Take her schedule—I want to know their patrol patterns. Leave her alive, though. I want her telling all her friends how vulnerable they really are.

description: Rosalind the Red needs a specific type of cave mushroom that only grows in the deep mines of Ebonpeak. The Stonelord Assembly tightly controls access to these mushrooms, selling them at prices Rosalind finds extortionate. She wants you to acquire some directly from the source—specifically from Brom the Miner's personal stash.
hook: Those dwarves charge ten times what these mushrooms are worth! They grow in caves! Caves! They're practically weeds down there! Brom keeps a personal collection of the best specimens—he's a miner, not an alchemist, what does he need them for? Relieve him of some. I'll pay fairly, unlike certain mountain-dwelling profiteers.

description: Kael the Watcher has spotted a cave troll in The Underdark Chasm that's been blocking access to a rich mushroom grove. He can't take it down alone, but he knows the grove would provide months of harvest. He wants help damaging the troll enough to drive it deeper into the chasm—he doesn't need it killed, just convinced to relocate.
hook: There's a mushroom grove down there that would feed a village. But a troll's claimed it as its territory. I've watched it—it's smart enough to avoid fights it can't win. If we hit it hard together, wound it badly, it'll retreat deeper and find new territory. I need those mushrooms. You need coin. Let's help each other.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "The Priest's Stolen Chalice", "Giver": "SeleneStarfall", "Actions": ["goto Riverwood", "stealth SilasTheSly", "take SilverRing", "goto VerdantGlade", "give SeleneStarfall SilverRing"]}}
description: Selene Starfall's ceremonial chalice—a silver vessel used in important Circle rituals—was stolen during a visit to Riverwood. She believes Silas the Sly, who was performing in the village at the time, is responsible. The chalice has minimal material value but immense spiritual importance to her.
hook: That chalice has blessed every Circle ceremony for three hundred years. It's not worth much as silver—it's thin, ancient, delicate. But to me, to the Circle, it's irreplaceable. Silas took it because he could, because stealing from a priestess amused him. Please, retrieve it. I don't care how—just bring it home to the Glade.

description: Isolde the Fair is performing at the Riverwood Harvest Festival, and Mayor Alistair is concerned about potential troublemakers. Some of her songs gently mock local figures, including a certain Syndicate member she once knew. The Mayor wants someone to keep an eye on the crowd and ensure nothing disrupts her performance.
hook: Isolde's got a sharp tongue and a beautiful voice. She's also got a habit of singing about people who'd rather not be sung about. I just want the festival to go smoothly—no fights, no 'accidents,' no one dragging her off stage. Stand near the front. Look like you'd be trouble to start trouble with.

output: {"Quest": {"Name": "Attack the Circle's Garden", "Giver": "NyxNightshade", "Actions": ["goto VerdantGlade", "damage WrenWillowwood"]}}
description: Nyx Nightshade wants to hurt the Circle of the Crescent by damaging one of their food sources. She's identified Wren Willowwood's farm as the primary supplier of ritual ingredients for the Circle. Rough up Wren, destroy some crops, and leave. This is about making the Circle feel vulnerable.
hook: The Circle thinks they're so pure, so above the concerns of 'lesser' folk. Let's remind them they need to eat like everyone else. Wren's farm feeds their precious rituals. Visit her. Make it clear that her connection to the Circle makes her a target. Break some things. Leave her scared, not dead—fear spreads faster than corpses.

description: Sskathiss has a territorial dispute with Finn the Fisherman over fishing rights in a particular stretch of river that borders both Riverwood and the Marsh. Sskathiss wants to send a message by stealing Finn's daily catch. He finds the whole concept of owning a river absurd but is willing to play by human rules to make his point.
hook: Finn claims this water is 'his.' Claims his village 'owns' the fish that swim through. The marsh folk know better—water belongs to itself. But Finn won't listen to reason. So we speak his language. Take his catch. Show him that claiming something doesn't make it yours. The fish will taste the same regardless.

input: {"NPCs": {"PetraStrong": {"Name": "Petra Strong", "Role": "BountyHunter", "Faction": "TheIronLegion", "CurrentLocation": "Ironfort", "OwnedItems": {"IronSword": 1, "LeatherArmor": 1, "GoldCoin": 25, "HealthPotion": 1}, "Relations": [{"Target": "TheWanderer", "Favorability": 30}]}}, "Locations": {"FrostfangMountains": {"Name": "Frostfang Mountains", "Enemies": ["DireWolf", "Troll", "OrcShaman", "BloodHarpy", "Specter"], "Resources": ["IronOre", "TrollFat", "WolfPelt", "MagicGem", "HarpyFeather"]}, "Ironfort": {"Name": "Ironfort", "Enemies": ["Bandit", "Wolf", "OrcBerserker"]}}, "Enemies": {"Specter": {"Name": "Specter", "Loot": ["ManaPotion", "SilverRing", "AncientScroll"]}}}

description: Petra Strong encountered specters during a patrol in the Frostfang Mountains—ghostly apparitions near an ancient battlefield. They attacked without warning and nearly overwhelmed her squad. The Legion wants these spirits cleared before they send more patrols through the area.
hook: I don't scare easy, but those things... they came out of nowhere. Just cold and screaming and wrong. My squad barely made it back. The Legion needs that pass clear—it's the fastest route to the northern outposts. Clear out those specters, and I'll make sure you're compensated for facing what most soldiers would run from.

description: Revas Vengeance has a personal vendetta against Darius the Daring, an Iron Legion bounty hunter who's killed three Syndicate members in the past month. The Syndicate has authorized a lethal response. Darius is currently camped in The Golden Plain, hunting another target. Revas wants him eliminated before he kills more Syndicate operatives.
hook: Darius. That self-righteous Legion dog has been hunting my people like animals. He's killed friends of mine. People I owed debts to. People who owed me debts. The Syndicate wants him dead, and frankly, so do I. Find him in the Golden Plain. End his little crusade. Do this, and you'll have friends in dark places for life. But know this—the Legion won't forgive this. Are you ready to choose sides?
